'''Fenn Sesslyn''' was the [[Chief of Security|Security Chief]] of the [[SoroSuub Corporation corporate security force]] in [[G'rinn Go city]]. A native of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], Sesslyn was known for being direct with [[Gender/Legends|her]] employees and not showing leniency toward lawbreakers.<ref name="Strongholds" />
